Name: TwitchCars
Author: Digitalsabre
Description:
This mod replaces some (eventually all) of the graffiti on train cars with various streamers known for playing Stardew Valley.

No, this doesn't include the most popular streamers in the category.  If you think your favorite streamer should make their way into the pack, they will have to contact me.  I have contacted several other people, who have failed to respond so far, so let your favorite streamer know that they should reach out.  I'm CallMeSabs on Twitch, CallMeSabs#0274 on Discord, digitalsabre on Twitter, and my email address is callmesabs@gmail.com


With further ado, here are the current streamers represented:

I'm not asking for money to do this.  As a streamer who likes to focus on Stardew myself, I'm doing it out of love for the game and the community surrounding it.  permission has been granted by the streamers represented to include their emotes in this mod.
